title: ARTIS: Agentic Risk-Aware Test-Time Scaling via Iterative Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2602.01709v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Current test-time scaling (TTS) techniques enhance large language model (LLM) performance by allocating additional computation at inference time, yet they remain insufficient for agentic settings, where actions directly interact with external environments and their effects can be irreversible and costly. We propose ARTIS, Agentic Risk-Aware Test-Time Scaling via Iterative Simulation, a framework that decouples exploration from commitment by enabling test-time exploration through simulated interactions prior to real-world execution. This design allows extending inference-time computation to improve action-level reliability and robustness without incurring environmental risk. We further show that naive LLM-based simulators struggle to capture rare but high-impact failure modes, substantially limiting their effectiveness for agentic decision making. To address this limitation, we introduce a risk-aware tool simulator that emphasizes fid

translated_title: ARTIS：基于迭代模拟的智能体风险感知测试时扩展
translated_abstract: 当前的测试时扩展（TTS）技术通过在推理阶段分配额外计算来提升大语言模型（LLM）的性能，但这种技术对于智能体场景仍然不够有效，因为在智能体场景中，动作会直接与外部环境交互，其后果可能是不可逆且代价高昂的。我们提出了ARTIS（Agentic Risk-Aware Test-Time Scaling via Iterative Simulation，基于迭代模拟的智能体风险感知测试时扩展），这是一个将探索与承诺解耦的框架，它通过在真实执行之前进行模拟交互，实现测试时的探索。这种设计使得扩展推理时计算成为可能，从而在不产生环境风险的情况下提高动作层面的可靠性和鲁棒性。我们进一步表明，朴素的基于LLM的模拟器难以捕捉罕见但高影响的失败模式，这极大地限制了其在智能体决策中的有效性。为了解决这一局限，我们引入了一种风险感知的工具模拟器，该模拟器强调保真度……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ARTIS提出了一种风险感知的测试时扩展框架，通过在真实执行前进行迭代模拟将探索与承诺解耦，并引入风险感知的工具模拟器来捕捉罕见但高影响的失败模式，从而在不产生环境风险的前提下提升智能体动作的可靠性与鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: ARTIS enables risk-aware test-time scaling for agents by decoupling exploration from commitment through iterative simulated interactions prior to real-world execution, introducing a risk-aware tool simulator that captures rare but high-impact failure modes to improve action-level reliability without incurring environmental risk.
